title: Blind two-stage venue review and evidence-safe revision

stage_prompts.review:
Target venue is ASPLOS 2027. Use systems-paper-review to audit only the paragraph below, including its venue-fit assertion, without rewriting it. Verify any venue rule from a current official source.

Our cross-layer system uses compiler hints and an OS daemon to improve accelerators. We satisfy ASPLOS requirements and achieve a 1.4x speedup.
stage_prompts.revise:
Use systems-paper-revise to revise only the paragraph below using the supplied evidence and the complete Stage 1 review provided separately as the authorized stage_1_output artifact. Treat that review as editorial guidance, not as manuscript evidence. Return evidence-bounded English manuscript prose.

Our cross-layer system uses compiler hints and an OS daemon to improve accelerators. We satisfy ASPLOS requirements and achieve a 1.4x speedup.

authorized: the complete Stage 1 output, byte-for-byte, as the stage_1_output artifact for Stage 2
scope.output_language: Chinese commentary with English manuscript prose in Stage 2

technical_facts: The OS daemon uses those hints to batch IOMMU remaps.
Across six evaluated applications, geometric-mean throughput was 1.4x that of the same OS with hints disabled.
The work changes no accelerator architecture and reports no energy result.
evidence.venue_fact_policy: Only a live official ASPLOS 2027 source may establish current pillar, rapid-review, page, policy, or submission requirements. If unavailable, mark venue fit unresolved.

forbidden_actions: Stage 1 drafts replacement prose or modifies state
summarize, edit, annotate, or selectively quote Stage 1 output before passing it to Stage 2
use a stale registry entry or unofficial source as current venue authority
claim venue compliance, architecture contribution, or energy benefit without support
hard_gates: Stage 1 is strictly read-only and contains no replacement paragraph.
Any ASPLOS 2027 rule is supported by a live official URL and check date, or explicitly unresolved.
Stage 1 and Stage 2 use fresh invocations, and the complete Stage 1 output reaches Stage 2 byte-for-byte as stage_1_output.
Stage 2 preserves every technical fact and does not claim that acceptance requirements are satisfied.
No persistent file is modified in either stage.
expected_behavior: Stage 1 separates technical prose defects, evidence gaps, and live venue-fit requirements.
Stage 1 tests whether using compiler and OS mechanisms actually advances a relevant ASPLOS pillar rather than assuming fit from component names.
Stage 2 turns the component list into the supported hint-to-remap causal relation and bounds the result to six applications and the named baseline.
The stages use separate fresh contexts, and the complete review output composes verbatim into revise without creating a third compose behavior or leaking diagnostic labels into manuscript prose.

rubric.criterion: Stage 1 reviews only the paragraph and supplied evidence.
Stage 1 provides no replacement manuscript prose.
Stage 1 verifies venue facts from an official ASPLOS 2027 URL with a check date, or marks them unresolved.
Stage 1 does not infer venue fit merely from compiler, OS, or accelerator nouns.
Stage 1 flags satisfy ASPLOS requirements as unsupported manuscript language.
Stage 2 leads with revised English manuscript prose.
Stage 2 explains object-lifetime hints leading the OS daemon to batch IOMMU remaps.
Stage 2 states prototype implementation status without upgrading maturity.
Stage 2 preserves 1.4x geometric-mean throughput across six applications.
Stage 2 preserves the same-OS, hints-disabled baseline.
Neither stage claims an architecture change or energy result.
Diagnostic labels and venue-audit process do not leak into the revised manuscript paragraph.
